mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a quarter indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% in a month signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a potential for monetary easing, which reduces discount rates and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.
